scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Declare both streaming schemas and watermark policies
cases.input_contract: Read the owned impression and click file directories with their explicit schemas, maxFilesPerTrigger 1 and five-minute watermarks on their respective event-time columns.
cases.expected: Both relations are streaming;the minimum multiple-watermark policy isexplicit and no query runs merely fromconstruction.
cases.verification: Assert both streaming flags, the declared timestamp fields and policymin before execution.

cases.title: Express key equality and the exact time range
cases.input_contract: Build either an inner orleft_outer join using key equality, click_time>=impression_time and click_time<impression_time+10minutes. Project impression_id, click_id and both timestamps.
cases.expected: A streaming relation with the four declared columns. The condition can matchi 1/c1 and i 3/c2 butnot boundaryclickc 3.
cases.verification: Assert output shape and reject an unsupported kind value;later exact pair checks validate both predicates.

cases.title: Run inner and outer queries with separate owned recovery state
cases.input_contract: Execute a named join kind with AvailableNow, Parquet append and its own checkpoint/output paths. Await at most 30 seconds and stop in finally. Run both kinds for the first input phase.
cases.expected: Each query consumes 7 source rows across its two inputs and terminates. The two checkpoints are distinct.
cases.verification: Assert input 7 for each query and inactive state after both bounded runs;do not combine their processing counts into 14 unique source events.

cases.title: Distinguish immediate matches frompending unmatched impressions
cases.input_contract: Read either owned output as ordered(impression_id, click_id) pairs. After phase 1, compare inner and outer sinks with the two-pair literal oracle.
cases.expected: Both sinks contain(i1, c1),(i3, c2). i2/NULL isabsent because its possible match interval isnot yet finalized. c3 and c 4 produce no pair.
cases.verification: Assert exact pair lists and absence of prematurei 2/NULL;do not rely only on output count 2.

cases.title: Advance both sides and observe delayed outer finalization
cases.input_contract: Publish distinct-key 00:30 advancers toboth sources, rerun both compatible queries and extract actual watermark/state-removal evidence.
cases.expected: Inner remains two pairs. Outer becomes(i1, c1),(i2, NULL),(i3, c2). Actual watermark reaches at least 00:25 and state removal ispositive;the new advancer impression remains pending.
cases.verification: Assert the complete outer ledger, input 2 for each new run, observed progress boundary and removed-state count.

cases.title: Reject an outer join without an event-time bound
cases.input_contract: In a separate owned checkpoint/output namespace, attempt a stream-stream left outer join using only key equality despite input watermarks. Require analysis rejection and stop any unexpectedly created query.
cases.expected: AnalysisException because this design lacks the required bounded match/finalization condition. The valid inner/outer sinks remain unchanged and no query isactive.
cases.verification: Assert the named rejection, inactive state and unchanged final valid outer pairs.
